name: neuronal PAS domain protein 1

function.text: NPAS1 is the approved symbol for neuronal PAS domain protein 1. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in DNA-binding transcription factor activity; DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; central nervous system development.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Bladder urothelial carcinoma; Cutaneous melanoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.
